scope: Read-only pinned GGUF header/tensor audit for the 32-bit Q8 GEMM descriptor/address contract
limitations: This inventory checks each complete Q8_0 matrix tensor and its pinned model bytes. It does not run inference or measure performance.
Both existing and packed Q8 GEMM kernels retain their 32-bit byte-address ABI. The new guard rejects unsupported whole-buffer sizes and matrix extents before GPU recording.
The archived GPU support and A/B records keep their original package/source identities. Host bounds policy has independent CPU tests; this metadata audit does not recertify an archive.
